summary: Frontend audit pass for Shamanic Elements Soul Temple. Logged in as QA user demoqa_740fefc1@example.com. Verified navigation, menu labels, Sacred Access consolidation, admin-text removal, All Alchemy Hub partition (84=14+14+56), Solar Cycle panel on /sun-moon, sound-frequencies (no Nature Sounds), pricing (3 AUD plans), admin API 401 for non-admin, Dashboard 'Sacred Journey' widget. Meditations premium lock modal shows ONLY 'Sacred Access' + 'Close' (single-button consolidation confirmed). Healing Portals header and portal-modal show a single Sacred Access CTA. Two menu regressions found: 'Sacred Guardians' entry still appears in the main /menu (MainMenuContainer.jsx:174) and in LinksPage.jsx:55; BottomNav.jsx has TWO 'Sacred Allies' entries (label duplicate at lines 80-81 — second should be 'Power & Spirit Animals'). Mantras audio functional test could not be fully executed via <audio> element because (a) only Om carries an audio_url (Wikipedia .ogg) which triggers audioError in Chromium and flips the modal to the chanting-timer fallback UI, hiding the audio-play-btn; (b) 'Voice Mantra' uses window.speechSynthesis, not an <audio> element, so paused/playbackRate/muted cannot be observed on any DOM audio node. Tempo Fast/Normal/Slow buttons only reprogram the internal chanting interval — they don't drive playbackRate on any audio element in this state. Recommend either always rendering a single controllable <audio>/TTS proxy per selected mantra, or hardening hasPlayableAudio to fall back to a working sample so QA can verify Play/Pause/Rate/Mute functionally.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Sacred Guardians' entry still rendered in /menu (should be removed per spec)
'Sacred Guardians' menu entry still present pointing to /sacred-guardians

Two entries labeled 'Sacred Allies' (duplicate label). Line 80 points to /sacred-ally-alchemy fallback /sacred-guardians; line 81 also labels 'Sacred Allies'. TopNav uses 'Power & Spirit Animals' for the equivalent entry — BottomNav second entry likely should be 'Power & Spirit Animals'.

For Om (only mantra with audio_url — Wikipedia .ogg) hasPlayableAudio resolves false in Chromium (audioError). Result: audio-play-btn never rendered, so functional Play/Pause/rate/mute cannot be exercised on any <audio> element. Consider hosting a compatible mp3/wav or provide a persistent audio element wrapper for TTS to enable QA & UX.

Voice Mantra button uses window.speechSynthesis rather than an <audio> tag, so playbackRate/muted/paused cannot be inspected via DOM. This also means the Slow/Normal/Fast tempo control changes the JS chanting interval only — it does NOT alter TTS or any audio.playbackRate. Consider wiring tempo -> utterance.rate for consistency.

Header 'View Subscription' and 'Full App 369.00' buttons are still visible for non-subscribed users. Not in scope of this pass but similar consolidation to Healing Portals/Meditations may be desired for consistency.

critical_code_review_comments: MainMenuContainer.jsx:174 still ships a 'Sacred Guardians' tile pointing to /sacred-guardians — contradicts stated consolidation goal.
LinksPage.jsx:55 lists 'Sacred Guardians' with '37 spirit guides & totems' — remove or rename to Sacred Allies to match new IA.
BottomNav.jsx:80-81 has two consecutive items labeled 'Sacred Allies' — the second is likely intended to be 'Power & Spirit Animals' (matches TopNav.jsx:114).

MantrasPlayer.jsx branches on hasPlayableAudio which fails silently when audio_url points to .ogg (unsupported in some browsers) — consider format fallback or better error surface, otherwise the entire Audio-driven Play/Pause/Rate/Mute UX is unreachable for every mantra in production.

Speed/tempo controls (mantra-tempo-*-btn) do not propagate to speechSynthesis utterance.rate nor to any <audio>.playbackRate — they only change the setInterval used by the chanting timer. This makes the 'Speed' functional requirement effectively unmet.
